issue.title: fix(compiler): add equiv & disp attributes to Xliff2 ICU placeholders

labels.name: area: i18n
labels.description: Issues related to localization and internationalization

issue.body:
## PR Type
What kind of change does this PR introduce?
```
[x] Bugfix
```

## What is the current behavior?
We didn't add the equiv & disp parameters to xliff 2 ICU placeholders. This generated an error when we were loading xliff 2 translations (by the way I'm not sure why we trigger an error in this case, since ["equiv" is optional](http://docs.oasis-open.org/xliff/xliff-core/v2.0/os/xliff-core-v2.0-os.html#equiv)).

Issue Number: #17344


## What is the new behavior?
Xliff 2 ICU placeholders now have equiv & disp parameters.
For disp I chose to represent ICU expressions as `{count, plural, =0 {...} =other {...}}`. I didn't want to write the complete ICU expression since it can be nested, what do you think @vicb? I can change it for something else if you prefer.
I also added tests for ICU placeholders for xmb/xliff/xliff2 because I noticed that we didn't have any.

## Does this PR introduce a breaking change?
```
[x] No
```

issue.title: Fix & improve attributes for xliff, xmb & xliff 2 placeholders

labels.name: area: i18n
labels.description: Issues related to localization and internationalization

issue.body:
## PR Type
What kind of change does this PR introduce?
```
[x] Bugfix
[x] Feature
```

## What is the current behavior?
#### Xliff & XMB:
We didn't add the equiv & disp parameters to xliff 2 ICU placeholders. This generated an error when we were loading xliff 2 translations (by the way I'm not sure why we trigger an error in this case, since ["equiv" is optional](http://docs.oasis-open.org/xliff/xliff-core/v2.0/os/xliff-core-v2.0-os.html#equiv)).

Issue Number: #17344

#### Xliff 2:
Xliff 2 uses `disp` attributes to represent the placeholders (interpolations/tags) content so that tools can display something when you're translating.
Xliff doesn't have this, and xmb outputs `INTERPOLATION` for interpolations instead of the actual interpolation value.

Issue Number: #17345


## What is the new behavior?
#### Xliff:
- added "equiv-text" attribute on interpolation placeholders

#### Xmb:
- replaced `INTERPOLATION` with the actual value of the interpolation in the `<ex>` tag of interpolation placeholders

#### Xliff 2:
Xliff 2 ICU placeholders now have equiv & disp parameters.
For disp I chose to represent ICU expressions as `{count, plural, =0 {...} =other {...}}`. I didn't want to write the complete ICU expression since it can be nested, what do you think @vicb? I can change it for something else if you prefer.
I also added tests for ICU placeholders for xmb/xliff/xliff2 because I noticed that we didn't have any.

## Does this PR introduce a breaking change?
```
[x] No
```

issue.title: handle ICU equiv in XLIFF 2.0

repository.name: ngx-i18nsupport-lib
repository.description: A Typescript Library to work with Angular generated i18n files (xliff, xmb)

issue.body:
There is a fixed issue in angular 4.3.2: `XLIFF 2.0 file created by the extract tool misses equiv="ICU"` angular/angular#17344.
ICU messages in XLIFF 2.0 now will have an equiv="ICU".
This must be handled correctly by the lib.
(which is not the case in the moment)
